name: Power Cup (tube type)

origin.basis: French tire maker; Michelin's UK site lists its bicycle range and dealers.

manufacturing.basis: Michelin's size list does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Michelin's tube-type Power Cup for racing and training, with GUM-X and an aramid crown shield.
hookless_note: Michelin lists every size of this tube-type tire for hooked rims only.
weight_basis: Michelin's size list shows no weights; no maker weight was found.
pressure_note: Michelin's size list gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Sold by Michelin's official Tmall store in mainland China; listed on Michelin's UK site with a dealer locator; North American availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.market: Michelin official Tmall store (米其林官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 373.08.

caveats: No independent lab test of the current tube-type version was applied.

image.shown: 700x25C Power Cup tube-type tire as pictured on Michelin's product page.
image.alt: Michelin Power Cup tube-type road tire standing upright at an angle

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: One of the owner's favourite road tires: super grip and rolls very well.
Oily residue from new made the tires erratic on wet roads until scrubbed.
Really great tires, but grip gave way in hard technical cornering on 23/25 mm sizes on wide rims.
No grip issues on 21 mm rims after Specialized Turbo Cottons.
Unbeatable cornering grip, just slightly slower than the GP5000, especially at lower pressures.
Excellent cornering and no cuts after 150 hard kilometres; full trust.
Superior ride quality, more cornering confidence than the GP5000 and equally fast with latex tubes.
Bags of grip, better handling than the GP5000 and new personal records, but a stone cut a sidewall beyond repair after about 700 miles.
Fantastic clinchers that replaced the GP5000 for the owner.
